---
title: "Use parameters"
---

{{< include _includes/preset-help-usage.qmd >}}

::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?** Sheet [👤]{.excel-menu .darkred} (**Nutzungsparameter**).
:::

Use data connects floor areas with user electricity, lighting and internal heat gains. Use-specific assumptions affect both electricity demand and the thermal model.

::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?**

| Input area | Editing and checking |
|---|---|
| User electricity | Check annual consumption or scaling by use; distinguish temporal profile from annual quantity |
| Internal loads and heat gains | Check heating and cooling assumptions and their effect on heating/cooling demand |
| Common-area electricity | Check assumptions for shared consumers |
| Lighting and daylight control | Check use, scaling and control assumptions; avoid double counting with user electricity |

Recalculate and compare user electricity and internal gains on the [results sheet](results.qmd). Set the underlying floor areas on [🏙]{.excel-menu .darkred} **Quartier**.
:::

::: {.declaration-note}
**Declaration:** User electricity and internal heat gains may be varied for modelling studies. Verification requires the designated declaration values. [AUDIT](declaration.qmd#qualitaetssicherung) helps identify deviations.
:::

Technical context: [Training, slides 11, 30 and 35](../downloads/schulung.pdf#page=35). Field reference: manual pp. 72–73 (German).
